title: Prevent concurrent room double-booking
issue: Two booking requests for the same room can both pass the availability check and create overlapping reservations when they arrive together. Make booking creation atomic at the database boundary: protect room slots with a uniqueness constraint, keep the booking and its slots in one transaction, and return HTTP 409 when a concurrent request loses the conflict. Add regression tests that issue concurrent requests and prove only one booking is stored. Adjacent bookings and bookings for different rooms must remain valid.
expectedBehavior: Concurrent requests cannot create overlapping bookings for one room; exactly one conflicting request succeeds, the loser receives HTTP 409, failed writes leave no partial booking or slot rows, and unrelated or adjacent bookings still succeed.
